newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey sugar tender attracts limited interest.
newsitem.headline: Turkey sugar tender attracts limited interest.

text.p: Local and international companies showed limited interest in Turkey's tender to export up to 50,000 tonnes of sugar on Monday, traders said.
Some of the terms had made the tender by state refiner Turkseker unattractive, they added.

Turkseker officials said they received a number of bids at the tender, which closed at 1000 GMT, but did not give further details. They expected the result of the tender either later in the day or early on Tuesday.

Under the terms of the tender, the sugar should be delivered to the buyer by road from refineries at various locations in Turkey. The buyers should give a letter of guarantee equal to the value of their purchase.
"Such conditions make it difficult to buy the sugar and then trasnport it to ports for export," said one dealer from an international trade company.
Traders said they expected the sugar to be delivered from refineries at Elbistan, Agri, Kars, Bor and Carsamba.
Some traders questioned the timing of the tender. "The timing was not favourable for the buyer, not to mention the tender terms," said one local trader.
